title: Niacinamide Night Cream: Why Vitamin B3 Works Well at Night
ex: Niacinamide (vitamin B3) is one of the gentlest actives for a night cream. Learn what it does, how to choose one for your skin type, and how to use it.
rt: Niacinamide Night Cream: Vitamin B3 Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: A niacinamide night cream supports smoother, more even-looking skin. Learn what vitamin B3 does, how to pick one for your skin type and how to use it well.
quick: A niacinamide night cream is a moisturiser with vitamin B3. Niacinamide is gentle, pairs well with ingredients like kojic acid, helps oily skin look less shiny and supports a more even-looking tone. Use a pea-sized amount each night on clean skin, and wear sunscreen in the morning.
facts: Niacinamide is a form of vitamin B3, also called nicotinamide.
Niacinamide is different from niacin, which can cause flushing as a supplement.
